note: Cities with a page, by Census place GEOID (state FIPS + place code). Each row was read by hand on the city's own site on the day `read` names; only https links to the city's own pages, never a page for one parcel. A city needs a `permits` and a `zoning` row. `county` is the county the city's page sits under (most of the city is in it; `other_counties` says parts of the city are in other counties). `built` and `value` are the Census's medians for the city, filled by build-data.cjs.

sources.homes: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates, tables B25035 (median year structure built) and B25077 (median value, owner-occupied housing units), place geography

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Altamonte Springs, Building and Fire Safety Department
rows.line: Licensed contractors obtain specific permits, check permit status and schedule inspections through the Civic Access portal; permits online are limited to those needing no plan review or attached to a building permit already reviewed and issued.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Altamonte Springs?
rows.a: In Altamonte Springs, permits and inspections are handled by the City's Building and Fire Safety Department. Licensed contractors can obtain specific permits, check their status and schedule inspections through the Civic Access portal, limited to permits that need no plan review or belong to a building permit already reviewed and issued.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Altamonte Springs, Planning and Development Division
rows.line: Administers the City's Land Development Code and implements City Plan 2030, the comprehensive plan; rezonings, conditional uses and variances need a pre-application conference with division staff.
rows.q: Where is Altamonte Springs' zoning?
rows.a: The City of Altamonte Springs' Planning and Development Division administers the City's Land Development Code and implements City Plan 2030, its comprehensive plan. Rezonings, conditional uses and variances require a pre-application conference with division staff.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gainesville Building Division
rows.line: Takes permit applications online through PermitGNV, by email, by mail or in person; its PermitGNV portal also shows existing permits.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Gainesville?
rows.a: The City of Gainesville's Building Division issues building permits. Applications go in online through PermitGNV, by email, by mail or in person, and the PermitGNV portal also shows existing permits.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Gainesville Planning Division
rows.line: Holds each development to the city's Comprehensive Plan and Land Development Regulations; a Planner of the Day answers planning questions.
rows.q: Where is Gainesville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Gainesville's Planning Division applies the city's Comprehensive Plan and Land Development Regulations to each development, and its Planner of the Day answers planning questions.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Hialeah, Building Department
rows.line: Enforces the Florida Building Code and Miami-Dade County regulations: reviews permit applications, issues permits, inspects, issues certificates of completion and occupancy, keeps records of building plans and manages flood and elevation certificates.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Hialeah?
rows.a: The City of Hialeah's Building Department reviews building permit applications, issues permits and conducts inspections under the Florida Building Code and Miami-Dade County regulations. It also keeps records of building plans and blueprints and manages flood and elevation certificates.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Hialeah, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Zoning regulations, including zoning maps, land use designations and rules on permitted uses and building dimensions, govern land use; the division handles variances, rezoning and special use permits, and a Zoning Verification Letter confirms information about a specific property.
rows.q: Where is Hialeah's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Hialeah's Planning and Zoning Division sets the zoning regulations that govern land use, including zoning maps, land use designations and rules on permitted uses and building dimensions. It manages requests for variances, rezoning and special use permits, and a Zoning Verification Letter confirms information about a specific property.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Kissimmee Building Division, Permits & Inspections
rows.line: Most home projects still need a permit under Florida's rules that took effect July 1, 2026, and the City must be told first even when one isn't needed; the Building Division works under the Florida Building Code.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Kissimmee?
rows.a: The City of Kissimmee's Building Division issues building permits under the Florida Building Code. Under Florida's rules that took effect July 1, 2026, most home projects still need a permit, and the City must be told first even when one isn't needed.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Kissimmee, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: Finds a property's zoning category online; the Development Code sets the use and design rules, and use and plan reviews are applied for here.
rows.q: Where is Kissimmee's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Kissimmee's Planning & Zoning pages find a property's zoning category online. The city's Development Code sets the use and design rules for development, and use and plan reviews are applied for there.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Miami, Permits & Construction
rows.line: Permits go through the City's digital systems, iBuild and ePlan; its pages also search a property's permit history and schedule inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Miami?
rows.a: The City of Miami issues building permits through its digital permitting systems, iBuild and ePlan. Its Permits & Construction pages also search a property's permit history and schedule building inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Miami Office of Zoning
rows.line: Interprets and administers the Miami 21 Zoning Ordinance; its pages find a property's zoning category and issue zoning verification letters and waivers.
rows.q: Where is Miami's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Miami's Office of Zoning interprets and administers the city's zoning ordinance, Miami 21. Its pages find a property's zoning category and handle zoning verification letters, waivers and special permits.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Miami Beach, Building Department
rows.line: Supervises and regulates construction under the Florida Building Code and the City's Code of Ordinances; its page covers the permitting process, permitting checklists, applying for a permit, inspections and building recertification.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Miami Beach?
rows.a: The City of Miami Beach's Building Department regulates construction under the Florida Building Code and the City's Code of Ordinances. Its page covers the permitting process, permitting checklists, applying for a permit, inspections and building recertification.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Miami Beach, Planning Department
rows.line: Prepares, administers and maintains the City's comprehensive plans and the Land Development Regulations of the City Code, which the page calls the zoning code; the page links administrative zoning interpretations and the City's maps and guidelines.
rows.q: Where is Miami Beach's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Miami Beach's Planning Department prepares, administers and maintains the City's comprehensive plans and the Land Development Regulations of the City Code, its zoning code. Its page links the regulations, administrative zoning interpretations and the City's maps and guidelines.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Miami Gardens, Building Services Department
rows.line: A one-stop shop for construction and development, with Building, Engineering, and Business Licensing and Housing Compliance divisions, enforcing the Florida Building Code and other rules on construction and land use.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Miami Gardens?
rows.a: The City of Miami Gardens' Building Services Department is a one-stop shop for construction and development in the city, enforcing the Florida Building Code and other regulations on construction and land use. It includes the Building, Engineering, and Business Licensing and Housing Compliance divisions.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Miami Gardens, Planning and Zoning
rows.line: The Zoning and Land Development Code is chapter 34 of the City's Code of Ordinances; a pre-application is required for all new development or redevelopment.
rows.q: Where is Miami Gardens' zoning?
rows.a: Miami Gardens' Zoning and Land Development Code is chapter 34 of the City's Code of Ordinances. A pre-application with the Planning and Zoning Department is required for all new development or redevelopment in the city.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of North Port Development Services, Permitting
rows.line: Permits are applied for through the Accela Citizen Application, where an account brings real-time updates; Florida's CS/CS/HB 803, effective July 1, 2026, adds two building permit exemptions for single-family residences.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in North Port?
rows.a: The City of North Port takes permit applications through the Accela Citizen Application, an online portal where contractors, residents and businesses create an account, apply for permits and get real-time updates from Development Services. Since July 1, 2026, a state law, CS/CS/HB 803, gives single-family residences two new building permit exemptions.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of North Port Development Services, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Handles current and long-range planning, review and permitting of land development for compliance with the Unified Land Development Code; its office is on the first floor of City Hall.
rows.q: Where is North Port's zoning?
rows.a: The City of North Port's Planning and Zoning Division handles planning, review and permitting of land development for compliance with the Unified Land Development Code. Its page links the City Code, City Charter and ULDC, the Comprehensive Plan and the City's map portal.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Sarasota Development Services, Building & Permitting
rows.line: Reviews building plans and inspects every building project in the City for code compliance; permits are submitted and inspections requested online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Sarasota?
rows.a: The City of Sarasota's Building & Permitting division reviews building plans and inspects every building project in the City. Permits are submitted and inspections requested online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Sarasota Planning Department
rows.line: Its Long-Range Planning Division keeps the Sarasota City Plan, the comprehensive plan, and the City Zoning Code.
rows.q: Where is Sarasota's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Sarasota's Planning Department keeps the City Zoning Code; its Long-Range Planning Division develops and maintains the code and the Sarasota City Plan.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Tampa, Construction Services
rows.line: Issues every building permit and inspection for development inside the city.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Tampa?
rows.a: The City of Tampa's Construction Services Division reviews plans, issues building permits and inspects construction for property inside the city.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Tampa, Zoning Maps
rows.line: An interactive map of zoning districts inside the city limits; the zoning code is Chapter 27 of the city code.
rows.q: Where is Tampa's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Tampa's zoning maps show the zoning district of each property inside the city limits, by address. The zoning code itself is Chapter 27 of the City of Tampa Code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Chicago Department of Buildings, Permits
rows.line: A permit is required before most construction, demolition and repair work; the Department's Guide to Permits covers small and mid-sized projects for homeowners.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Chicago?
rows.a: The City of Chicago's Department of Buildings issues building permits; one is required before most construction, demolition and repair work. Its Guide to Permits covers small and mid-sized projects for homeowners, and its site checks a permit application's status.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Chicago Department of Planning and Development, Zoning Ordinance Administration
rows.line: Reviews building permit applications for compliance with the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, with plan examiners at City Hall.
rows.q: Where is Chicago's zoning?
rows.a: The Zoning Ordinance Administration Division of Chicago's Department of Planning and Development reviews building permit applications for compliance with the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, with plan examiners at City Hall.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Evanston Community Development, Building and Development Services
rows.line: Handles construction permitting, building inspections and property maintenance code enforcement; permit applications received on or after October 1, 2025 must comply with the Illinois Stretch Energy Code.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Evanston?
rows.a: The City of Evanston's Building and Development Services Division, in the Community Development Department, handles construction permitting, building inspections and property maintenance code enforcement. Its permit desk takes walk-ins Tuesday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to noon.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Evanston Community Development, Planning and Zoning
rows.line: Administers the Zoning Ordinance, Title 6 of the Evanston City Code, processes applications for zoning relief such as variations, and reviews building applications for construction permits for compliance.
rows.q: Where is Evanston's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Evanston's Planning and Zoning Division administers the Zoning Ordinance, Title 6 of the Evanston City Code. It reviews proposals and applications for compliance, processes applications for zoning relief such as variations, and provides zoning information on properties in the city.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Village of Skokie Community Development, How to Apply for a Building Permit
rows.line: Permits are applied for online through the Village's permit portal; both the homeowner and the contractor sign the forms, and a residential addition or new residential building needs a plat of survey created within 18 months.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Skokie?
rows.a: The Village of Skokie takes building permit applications online through its permit portal. Both the homeowner and the contractor must sign the forms, and a residential addition or new residential building must include a plat of survey created within 18 months.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Village of Skokie Community Development, Zoning Ordinances
rows.line: The official Zoning Map shows how a property is zoned, and the Zoning Chapter of the Skokie Village Code sets building density, height, landscaping, parking and permitted uses; a special use is allowed only after public hearings.
rows.q: Where is Skokie's zoning?
rows.a: The Village of Skokie regulates land use through zoning: its official Zoning Map shows how a property is zoned, and the Zoning Chapter of the Skokie Village Code sets rules on building density, height, parking and permitted uses. A special use is allowed only after public hearings, with Plan Commission review and the Village Board of Trustees' approval.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Saint Paul Safety and Inspections, Building Permits & Inspections
rows.line: Needed to build, add to or change a one- or two-family home or any other building in the city.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Saint Paul?
rows.a: The City of Saint Paul's Department of Safety and Inspections issues building permits in the city, for building, adding to or changing a home or any other building.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Saint Paul Safety and Inspections, Zoning Permits and Land Uses
rows.line: Zoning approval comes before a building permit; design standards are in chapter 63 of the city's zoning code.
rows.q: Where is Saint Paul's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Saint Paul's Department of Safety and Inspections reviews zoning, which a building permit, a license or a change of use needs first. The city's design standards are in chapter 63 of the Saint Paul Zoning Code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Independence Community Development, Building Inspections Division
rows.line: Issues building, plumbing and electrical permits and inspects all new residential and commercial construction that has a permit; permits are applied for, paid, printed and searched online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Independence?
rows.a: The City of Independence's Building Inspections Division issues permits, including plumbing, electrical and construction permits, and inspects new residential and commercial construction that has applied for a permit. Its page links applying for a permit, requesting an inspection and searching a permit's status online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Independence Community Development, Development Services
rows.line: Planning and Zoning staff administer the Unified Development Ordinance, which holds the zoning and subdivision regulations, and process zoning applications for the Planning Commission and Board of Adjustment.
rows.q: Where is Independence's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Independence's Planning and Zoning staff, in Development Services, administer the Unified Development Ordinance, which holds the City's zoning and subdivision regulations. They process zoning and development applications for recommendations to the Planning Commission and the Board of Adjustment.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Kansas City City Planning and Development, Permits Division
rows.line: Takes construction permit applications through CompassKC, from submittal to issuance; permit technicians see walk-in applicants on City Hall's 5th floor on weekdays.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Kansas City?
rows.a: The Permits Division of Kansas City's City Planning and Development Department processes construction permits from application to issuance. Applications go in online through CompassKC, and permit technicians see walk-in applicants on City Hall's 5th floor on weekdays.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Kansas City City Planning and Development, Zoning Verification
rows.line: A property's zoning can be looked up on the City's Parcel Viewer map, or confirmed by the Permits Division by phone, email or a zoning compliance letter.
rows.q: Where is Kansas City's zoning?
rows.a: Kansas City's City Planning and Development Department shows a property's zoning on the City's online Parcel Viewer map, and its Permits Division confirms it by phone, by email or with a zoning compliance letter.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Lee's Summit, Development Services
rows.line: Building permits for residential, commercial and other projects are available online or in person on the first floor of City Hall; a permit may be obtained by a licensed contractor, or by a homeowner for their primary residence only.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Lee's Summit?
rows.a: The City of Lee's Summit's Development Services Department issues building permits online or in person on the first floor of City Hall. A licensed contractor can obtain a permit, and so can a homeowner for their primary residence only.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Lee's Summit Development Services, Unified Development Ordinance
rows.line: The Unified Development Ordinance holds the City's zoning and subdivision platting regulations; in effect since November 1, 2001, it has been amended numerous times, and each article is posted with the date of its latest amendment.
rows.q: Where is Lee's Summit's zoning?
rows.a: Lee's Summit's zoning is in its Unified Development Ordinance, which includes the zoning and subdivision platting regulations that control the development and use of land. It took effect on November 1, 2001, has been amended numerous times since, and each article is posted separately with the date of its latest amendment.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Henderson Building and Fire Safety, Permits
rows.line: Its page leads to permit applications and checklists, a permit fee estimator, plan review status and building inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Henderson?
rows.a: The City of Henderson's Building and Fire Safety department issues building permits. Its permits page leads to the applications and checklists, a permit fee estimator, plan review status and scheduling building inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Henderson Community Development and Services, Planning Services
rows.line: Takes development applications from concept to final approval, makes recommendations to the Planning Commission and City Council, and answers questions about zoning.
rows.q: Where is Henderson's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Henderson's Planning Services division handles development applications from concept to final approval, makes recommendations to the Planning Commission and City Council, and answers questions about zoning.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Las Vegas Building & Safety, Building & Offsite Permits
rows.line: For property within city limits; zoning, design review or variances may come first, and a year-round amnesty program lets homeowners disclose unpermitted work without penalty fees.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Las Vegas?
rows.a: The City of Las Vegas's Building & Safety division issues building permits for property within city limits. Zoning, design review or variances may come first, and a year-round amnesty program lets homeowners disclose work done without a permit without penalties on the plan review and permit fees.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Las Vegas, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: The city's unified development code holds its zoning, subdivision and design standards; planning applications go in through CLV EPLAN.
rows.q: Where is Las Vegas's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Las Vegas's Planning & Zoning department keeps the city's zoning code, the unified development code with its subdivision, design and landscaping standards, and takes planning applications through CLV EPLAN.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of North Las Vegas Development Services, Building Safety
rows.line: Reviews plans, issues permits and inspects work under the city's code; many permits come through the Citizen Self-Service portal, and for a new single-family home the permit becomes the certificate of occupancy after the final inspection.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in North Las Vegas?
rows.a: The City of North Las Vegas's Building Safety Division reviews plans, issues building permits and inspects the work. Many permits and inspection requests go through its Citizen Self-Service portal, which needs an account.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of North Las Vegas, Planning and Zoning
rows.line: Current Planning reviews every development application, from land use proposals to building permits and home occupations; its page takes zoning verification letter requests.
rows.q: Where is North Las Vegas's zoning?
rows.a: The City of North Las Vegas's Planning and Zoning Division reviews every development application in the city, approving it or sending recommendations to the Planning Commission and City Council, and its page takes requests for zoning verification letters.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Fayetteville Development Services, Permitting & Inspections
rows.line: Issues permits, reviews plans and inspects buildings under the North Carolina building codes; its public portals hold permit records, plans and inspection reports by address.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Fayetteville?
rows.a: The City of Fayetteville's Permitting & Inspections divisions issue building permits, review plans and inspect buildings in the city. Permit records, plans and inspection reports for an address are in its E-Development portal, for projects submitted after 2021, and its Fayworx portal, for records from 2015 to 2021.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Fayetteville Development Services, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: Reviews and approves land development under the city's Unified Development Ordinance and handles variance requests and historic districts.
rows.q: Where is Fayetteville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Fayetteville's Planning & Zoning Division reviews and approves land development under the city's Unified Development Ordinance, and handles variance requests and its historic districts.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Canton Building / Code Enforcement, Permits / Licenses / Inspections
rows.line: Its online portal takes permit applications, schedules inspections and searches permits made since October 1, 2025; older permits are looked up by phone.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Canton?
rows.a: The City of Canton's Building / Code Enforcement office issues building permits. Its online portal takes applications, schedules inspections and searches permits made since October 1, 2025; older permits are looked up by calling the office.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Canton, Zoning
rows.line: A zoning permit comes before any new building, addition, deck, fence, shed, pool or sign; the office also says where uses are allowed and runs the Zoning Board of Appeals.
rows.q: Where is Canton's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Canton's zoning office issues the zoning permit needed before any new building, addition, deck, fence, shed, pool or sign, says what uses are allowed where, and runs the Zoning Board of Appeals for variances.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Columbus Department of Building and Zoning Services, Get or Track a Building Permit
rows.line: An application and any plans are routed to the departments that must review them, and the permit is issued once each review approves; the Citizen Access Portal tracks it.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Columbus?
rows.a: The City of Columbus's Department of Building and Zoning Services issues building permits. An application and any plans go to the departments that must review them, the permit is issued once each review approves, and the Citizen Access Portal tracks the application.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Columbus Department of Building and Zoning Services, Zoning
rows.line: Zoning sets setbacks, building heights, lot sizes and coverage, parking and the land uses allowed; the page leads to residential zoning clearance, the zoning map and the zoning code.
rows.q: Where is Columbus's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Columbus's Department of Building and Zoning Services administers zoning, which sets setbacks, building heights, lot sizes and coverage, parking and the land uses allowed on a property. Its page leads to residential zoning clearance, the zoning map and the zoning code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gahanna, Division of Building
rows.line: Issues permits, reviews plans, inspects construction and enforces building regulations; since May 2024 permit applications and inspection requests go through OpenGov, and paper applications are no longer accepted.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Gahanna?
rows.a: The City of Gahanna's Division of Building issues permits, reviews plans, inspects construction work and enforces building regulations. Since May 2024 it processes permit applications and inspection requests online through OpenGov, and it no longer accepts paper applications.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Gahanna, Division of Zoning
rows.line: Reviews projects under the Zoning Code: minor zoning permits, such as fence, shed and home occupation permits, may be approved by City staff, while variances and rezonings go through public hearings.
rows.q: Where is Gahanna's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Gahanna's Division of Zoning reviews projects and requests under the City's Zoning Code. Minor zoning permits, such as fence, shed and home occupation permits, may be approved by City staff, while conditional uses, variances and rezonings need review and approval by the Planning Commission and City Council, as applicable, through a public hearing.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Grove City, Building and Zoning Division
rows.line: Reviews building plans and issues permits for all construction, inspects new and existing buildings and oversees development in the City's floodplains; the building permit process must begin through the Building Division's online portal.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Grove City?
rows.a: The City of Grove City's Building and Zoning Division reviews building plans and issues permits for all construction, and inspects new and existing buildings. The building permit process must begin through the Building Division's online portal.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Grove City, Zoning Information
rows.line: Each zoning district's requirements are in the Planning and Zoning Code, the zoning map shows the districts' boundaries, and the interactive Grove City Zoning Map checks the zoning of a specific property or parcel.
rows.q: Where is Grove City's zoning?
rows.a: Grove City's requirements for each zoning district are in its Planning and Zoning Code, and the zoning map shows each district's boundaries. The interactive Grove City Zoning Map checks the zoning of a specific property or parcel.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Upper Arlington, Building Division
rows.line: Reviews residential and commercial construction plans, issues permits and registrations, and inspects buildings and mechanical systems under State of Ohio and City minimum building codes.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Upper Arlington?
rows.a: The City of Upper Arlington's Building Division reviews residential and commercial construction plans, issues permits and registrations, and provides onsite inspections, enforcing the State of Ohio's and the City's minimum building codes, including the Residential Code of Ohio.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Upper Arlington, Planning and Zoning Division
rows.line: Makes sure home and business improvement projects meet the City's zoning requirements, mainly in use and location; the Unified Development Ordinance sets the standards for zoning districts, site design, land use and building requirements.
rows.q: Where is Upper Arlington's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Upper Arlington's Planning and Zoning Division checks that home and business improvement projects meet the City's zoning requirements, primarily in use and location. Its Unified Development Ordinance establishes the standards for zoning districts, site design, land use and building requirements.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Edmond, Residential Building Permits
rows.line: Sorts home projects into the City's permit types: a new house, townhouse or duplex, an accessory building of 200 square feet or more, an alteration, or an addition.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Edmond?
rows.a: The City of Edmond issues residential building permits, sorted by project: a new house, townhouse or duplex, an accessory building of 200 square feet or more, an alteration, or an addition. Accessory dwelling units have their own permit.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Edmond, Zoning
rows.line: Rezoning follows the Edmond Plan, the City's comprehensive plan; a request that doesn't fit its land-use category first needs a plan amendment from the Planning Commission.
rows.q: Where is Edmond's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Edmond's zoning follows the Edmond Plan, its comprehensive plan. A rezoning request whose land use doesn't fit the plan's category first needs a comprehensive plan amendment approved by the Planning Commission.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Oklahoma City Development Services, Building & Trade Permits
rows.line: A permit is required to construct, alter, repair, enlarge, move or demolish any primary or accessory structure; residential permits are applied for online or at the Business Center at 420 W. Main St.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Oklahoma City?
rows.a: The City of Oklahoma City's Development Services issues building permits, required to construct, alter, repair, enlarge, move or demolish any primary or accessory structure. Residential permits are applied for online or at the Business Center at 420 W. Main St.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Oklahoma City, Subdivision & Zoning
rows.line: Zoning sets how land may be used and the development standards for all property in the city; the Planning Commission recommends zoning changes and the City Council approves them.
rows.q: Where is Oklahoma City's zoning?
rows.a: Oklahoma City's zoning sets how land may be used and the development standards for all property in the city. The Planning Commission makes recommendations on zoning changes, and the City Council has final approval.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gresham, Building Permits and Inspections
rows.line: Needed to build, enlarge, alter, repair or move a building or change its electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing systems; services are at City Hall, and permit and land use records can be looked up.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Gresham?
rows.a: The City of Gresham issues building permits for building, enlarging, altering, repairing or moving a building and for its electrical, gas, mechanical and plumbing systems. Permit services are at Gresham City Hall, and permit and land use records can be looked up online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Gresham Urban Design and Planning, Planner on Duty
rows.line: The interactive zoning map shows zoning designations and earlier permits; the Planner on Duty answers site-specific questions by email, phone or at City Hall.
rows.q: Where is Gresham's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Gresham's interactive zoning map shows a property's zoning designation and earlier permits, and the Planner on Duty answers site-specific planning questions by email, by phone or at City Hall.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Portland Permitting & Development, public records
rows.line: Building permit, land use review and code enforcement records for private property; many are online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Portland?
rows.a: Portland Permitting & Development issues building permits in the city and keeps its building permit, land use review and code enforcement records. Its public records page says which are online and how to ask for the rest.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Portland Permitting & Development, Zoning and Land Use
rows.line: The city's zoning code, its zoning maps and answers to common zoning questions.
rows.q: Where is Portland's zoning?

rows.line: ZIMAS, City Planning's map, looks up a property's zoning and land use designations and its planning case and building permit history, by address, parcel number and more.
rows.q: Where is Los Angeles's zoning?
rows.a: Los Angeles City Planning's ZIMAS map looks up a property's zoning and land use designations, along with its planning cases and building permit history, by address, parcel number and other ways.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Long Beach Community Development, Building and Safety Bureau
rows.line: Most residential, commercial and industrial construction, including alterations, replacements and repairs, needs a permit and inspections; historic districts and coastal zones may add requirements.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Long Beach?
rows.a: The City of Long Beach's Building and Safety Bureau issues building permits; most construction, alteration, replacement and repair work needs one, with inspections. Historic districts and coastal zones may add requirements.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Long Beach Planning Bureau, Zoning Maps
rows.line: The citywide and GIS zoning maps show a property's zoning district, which leads to its permitted uses and development standards.
rows.q: Where is Long Beach's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Long Beach's Planning Bureau publishes citywide and GIS zoning maps that show a property's zoning district, and the district's page gives its permitted uses and development standards.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Moreno Valley Community Development, Building and Safety Division
rows.line: Issues permits and provides plan check and inspections under the city's and the State's building codes; submittals after December 31, 2025 must meet the codes in effect January 1, 2026.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Moreno Valley?
rows.a: The City of Moreno Valley's Building and Safety Division issues building permits and provides plan check and inspections under the city's and the State's building codes.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Moreno Valley Community Development, 2040 General Plan and zoning
rows.line: The adopted zoning documents: the zoning map, the zoning atlas pages, the overlay maps and the permitted uses table, beside the 2040 General Plan's land use map.
rows.q: Where is Moreno Valley's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Moreno Valley's Community Development Department publishes its adopted zoning documents, including the zoning map, the zoning atlas pages and the permitted uses table, beside the 2040 General Plan's land use map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of San Bernardino Community Development and Housing, Building and Safety Division
rows.line: With a few minor exceptions, permits are required for all structural, electrical, plumbing, heating and air-conditioning work; minor jobs such as a water heater replacement are usually issued over the counter, and permit records from 1996 to the present can be searched online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in San Bernardino?
rows.a: The City of San Bernardino's Building and Safety Division issues building permits and inspects new and remodeled buildings on private property. With a few minor exceptions, permits are required for all structural, electrical, plumbing, heating and air-conditioning work, and permit records from 1996 to the present can be searched online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of San Bernardino Community Development and Housing, Planning Division
rows.line: Implements the City's General Plan and Development Code and manages land use entitlements for proposed residential, commercial and industrial projects under California's planning, zoning and development laws.
rows.q: Where is San Bernardino's zoning?
rows.a: The City of San Bernardino's Planning Division implements the City's General Plan and Development Code and manages land use entitlements for proposed residential, commercial and industrial projects, in line with California's planning, zoning and development laws. It also supports the Planning Commission.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Fontana Development Services, Building and Safety
rows.line: Permit and plan check applications are taken at the customer service counter or on the Build Fontana Public Portal, which also takes fees and schedules inspections; the office is closed every Friday.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Fontana?
rows.a: The City of Fontana's Building and Safety Department takes permit and plan check applications at its customer service counter and through the Build Fontana Public Portal, where people can also pay fees and schedule inspections. It is open Monday to Thursday and closed every Friday.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Fontana Development Services, Planning
rows.line: Every new development, and every modification or upgrade of a residential, commercial or industrial structure, is reviewed against the Development Code and the General Plan before construction; the page links the Zoning and General Plan Land Use Map.
rows.q: Where is Fontana's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Fontana's Planning Department processes land use applications and reviews every new development, and every modification or upgrade of an existing structure, against the Development Code, any applicable specific or community plan and the General Plan before construction begins. Its page links the City's Zoning and General Plan Land Use Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Rancho Cucamonga Community Development, Building and Safety
rows.line: All permits are applied for online through the Online Permit Center; the City does not issue permits over the counter.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Rancho Cucamonga?
rows.a: The City of Rancho Cucamonga's Building and Safety Department takes every permit application online, through its Online Permit Center, and does not issue permits over the counter. Permit questions can be sent by text, phone or email.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Rancho Cucamonga, Zoning Map
rows.line: Links the Zoning Plan Interactive Viewer maintained by the City.
rows.q: Where is Rancho Cucamonga's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Rancho Cucamonga maintains a Zoning Plan Interactive Viewer, linked from its Zoning Map page.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Ontario Community Development, Building Permit FAQs
rows.line: A homeowner who lives or will live in the house can obtain a permit and do the work; fees are based on the project's valuation, with a plan review fee equal to 80% of the permit fee, and a property's zone comes from the Planning Department.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Ontario?
rows.a: The City of Ontario issues building permits; a homeowner who lives or will live in the house can obtain one and do the work. Permit fees are based on the project's valuation, and a plan review fee equal to 80% of the permit fee is collected when the application is submitted.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Ontario Community Development, Planning
rows.line: The City's Zoning Map as a downloadable PDF, and an interactive map that searches the zoning designation of a property in Ontario.
rows.q: Where is Ontario's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Ontario's Planning page has its Zoning Map as a downloadable PDF and an interactive map that searches the zoning designation of properties in the city.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Temecula Community Development, Building and Safety
rows.line: Handles plan review, inspections and the enforcement of building codes and standards; permits for new homes, commercial buildings and solar systems are submitted digitally through the Citizen Self Service portal.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Temecula?
rows.a: The City of Temecula's Building and Safety Division handles plan review, inspections and the enforcement of building codes and standards. Permits for new homes, commercial buildings and solar systems are submitted digitally through its Citizen Self Service portal.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Temecula Community Development, Planning
rows.line: A property's zoning designation shows in the City's online GIS tool and on its Zoning Map, and the regulations are in the Zoning Chapter of the Temecula Municipal Code; a formal Zoning Letter can be requested.
rows.q: Where is Temecula's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Temecula's online GIS tool and Zoning Map show a property's zoning designation, and the Zoning Chapter of the Temecula Municipal Code holds the regulations. The Planner of the Day answers questions by phone, and the Planning Department issues formal Zoning Letters on request.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Murrieta Development Services, Building and Safety Division
rows.line: Administers building codes, fees, plan review and inspections; applications are submitted digitally through the Citizen Self-Service portal, a project needs an address and parcel number first, and the completeness check takes about 15 business days.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Murrieta?
rows.a: The City of Murrieta's Building and Safety Division administers building codes, fees, plan review and inspections. Permit applications are submitted digitally through its Citizen Self-Service portal, a project needs an address and assessor's parcel number before plans are submitted, and the completeness check takes approximately 15 business days.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Murrieta Development Services, Planning
rows.line: Holds the Murrieta Zoning Map and Land Use Map, and interactive GIS mapping that shows whether an address is within City limits; the City will update its zoning map for the land use changes adopted with the Murrieta General Plan 2035.
rows.q: Where is Murrieta's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Murrieta's Planning page holds the Murrieta Zoning Map and Land Use Map, and its interactive GIS mapping shows whether an address is within City limits. The City will be updating its zoning map to reflect the land use changes adopted with the Murrieta General Plan 2035.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Tracy Community and Economic Development, Building Safety Division
rows.line: Building permits are issued every working day at 333 Civic Center Plaza; residential permits can be applied for online through e-TRAKiT, which also tracks permits and schedules inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Tracy?
rows.a: The City of Tracy's Building Safety Division issues building permits every working day at 333 Civic Center Plaza. Residential permits can be applied for online through e-TRAKiT, which also tracks permits and schedules inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Tracy Community and Economic Development, Planning Division
rows.line: Carries out the City's development policies, checking projects against its Specific Plans, the Zoning Code, the Growth Management Ordinance, Planned Unit Developments and the Design Guidelines; its section holds the Zoning and General Plan Maps.
rows.q: Where is Tracy's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Tracy's Planning Division implements the City's development policies, checking projects for conformance with its Specific Plans, Zoning Code, Growth Management Ordinance, Planned Unit Developments and Design Guidelines. Its pages hold the General Plan and Zoning Ordinance and the Zoning and General Plan Maps.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Manteca Development Services, Building Safety
rows.line: Residents and contractors obtain building permits, research permit histories and schedule inspections through the online Citizen Access portal; approved plans must be printed and kept on site for inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Manteca?
rows.a: The City of Manteca issues building permits through its online Citizen Access portal, where residents and contractors can also research permit histories and schedule inspections. Approved plans and documents must be printed and kept on site for inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Manteca Development Services, Planning
rows.line: Title 17 of the Manteca Municipal Code holds the City's rules on land use, development and their permits; a draft comprehensive zoning code update addresses the 2043 General Plan Update and the 6th Cycle Housing Element.
rows.q: Where is Manteca's zoning?
rows.a: Manteca's zoning is Title 17 of the Manteca Municipal Code, the local laws on land use, development and development permits. A draft comprehensive zoning code update addresses the City's 2043 General Plan Update and its 6th Cycle Housing Element.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Lodi Community Development, Building Division
rows.line: Its Plan Check and Inspection sections guide builders through the California Building, Plumbing and Electrical Codes; residential permits can be applied for online through eTRAKiT, and the 2025 California Building Code took effect January 1, 2026.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Lodi?
rows.a: The City of Lodi's Building Division, through its Plan Check and Inspection sections, guides contractors, developers and property owners in meeting the California Building, Plumbing and Electrical Codes. Residential permits can be applied for online through eTRAKiT, and its monthly reports list permits issued, pending and finaled.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Lodi Community Development, Planning Division
rows.line: Zoning regulations are in the Lodi Development Code, which says whether a use is allowed, needs a use permit or is not allowed, and sets setbacks, height and parking; the GIS Property Viewer Map shows a property's planning layers.
rows.q: Where is Lodi's zoning?
rows.a: Lodi's zoning regulations are in the Lodi Development Code, which says whether a use is allowed, needs a use permit or minor use permit, or is not allowed in each zone, and sets controls like setbacks, height and parking. The City's GIS Property Viewer Map shows a property's zoning under its Planning layers.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Petaluma, City Permits
rows.line: Permits are applied for and inspections scheduled in the online Planning and Permits Hub; building construction permits, zoning and planning permits, and permits for work in the public right-of-way each have their own contact.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Petaluma?
rows.a: The City of Petaluma takes permit applications and schedules inspections in its online Planning and Permits Hub. Its permits page lists when a permit is needed, from new construction and remodels to additions, with separate contacts for building, planning and zoning, and right-of-way permits.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Petaluma, Planning
rows.line: The Zoning Ordinance divides the city into zones, each allowing specific activities and development, and sets rules on parking, landscaping and building height; the City suggests confirming a property's zoning before signing a lease or purchase agreement.
rows.q: Where is Petaluma's zoning?
rows.a: Petaluma's Zoning Ordinance divides the city into zones, each allowing specific activities and types of development, and sets requirements on parking, landscaping and building height. The City's Planning team answers zoning questions by email or in person at 11 English Street, given a property's address or Assessor's Parcel Number.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Pasadena Planning and Community Development, Permit Center
rows.line: A one-stop shop where staff from several departments provide development review and permitting; Permit Center Online researches a property, searches permits, checks a case's status and schedules inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Pasadena?
rows.a: The City of Pasadena's Permit Center is a one-stop shop where staff from several departments provide development review and permitting. Its Permit Center Online researches a property, searches for a permit, checks a case's status and schedules inspections.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Pasadena Planning Division, Current Planning and Zoning
rows.line: Applies the Zoning Code, which sets the zoning districts, land use regulations and development standards; the online code is updated after the City Council adopts an amendment, and the Zoning Administrator interprets it.
rows.q: Where is Pasadena's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Pasadena's Current Planning Section applies the Zoning Code, which describes the city's zoning districts, land use regulations and development standards. Its page links the online Zoning Code, updated after the City Council adopts an amendment, and the Pasadena Zoning Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Torrance Community Development, Building and Safety Permits
rows.line: Since January 5, 2026 every plan review and permit submittal is electronic, through the Citizen Access Portal; a project may first need an approved Zoning Screening, and mechanical, electrical and plumbing work need their own applications.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Torrance?
rows.a: The City of Torrance takes building permit applications electronically through its Citizen Access Portal; since January 5, 2026 paper plans are no longer accepted. A project may first need an approved Zoning Screening, and mechanical, electrical and plumbing work each need a separate permit application.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Torrance Community Development, Planning Division
rows.line: Its Development Review section checks development plans against land use policies and standards, processes development applications and answers inquiries on zoning and land use; Comprehensive Planning maintains the General Plan.
rows.q: Where is Torrance's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Torrance's Planning Division reviews development plans for conformance with land use policies and standards, processes development applications and responds to inquiries on zoning and land use. It also maintains the City's General Plan.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Pomona, Development Services
rows.line: The Building Safety Division reviews construction plans, issues building permits, provides inspections and ensures building code compliance; Development Services takes walk-ins at City Hall Monday to Thursday.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Pomona?
rows.a: The City of Pomona's Building Safety Division, in the Development Services Department, reviews construction plans, issues building permits, provides inspections and ensures building code compliance. Development Services takes walk-ins at City Hall, 505 South Garey Avenue, Monday to Thursday.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Pomona Development Services, Planning Division
rows.line: The Pomona Zoning and Development Code regulates design and land use in the city; its comprehensive update took effect July 31, 2024, and the current version is effective July 15, 2026.
rows.q: Where is Pomona's zoning?
rows.a: Pomona's zoning is in the Pomona Zoning and Development Code, the base code that regulates design and land use in the city. A comprehensive update took effect on July 31, 2024, and the Planning Division posts each later version, the current one effective July 15, 2026.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Vallejo, Central Permit Center
rows.line: A one-stop shop in City Hall for building, utility, special use, sign, tree and temporary permits, with information bulletins, checklists, standards and fees; permits are applied for online through eTRAKiT.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Vallejo?
rows.a: The City of Vallejo's Central Permit Center, in City Hall, handles building and other permits and gives technical assistance; its page has information bulletins, checklists, standards and fees. Permits are applied for online through eTRAKiT.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Vallejo, Building and Zoning
rows.line: The zoning section reviews license applications and building plans for the correct use of land and compliance with the City's development regulations, and supports the City Council on code interpretation, variances and appeals.
rows.q: Where is Vallejo's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Vallejo's zoning section reviews all license applications and building plans to ensure the correct use of land and compliance with the development regulations in City ordinances. It also supports the City Council on code interpretation, variance requests and administrative appeals.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Fairfield Community Development, Fairfield BUILD
rows.line: Fairfield BUILD, the City's online permitting system that replaced TRAKiT, takes permit applications, plans, payments and inspection requests for Building, Planning, Fire and Public Works.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Fairfield?
rows.a: The City of Fairfield takes permit applications through Fairfield BUILD, its online permitting system, which replaced TRAKiT. Applications, plans, payments and inspection requests for Building, Planning, Fire and Public Works all go through it, with an account.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Fairfield Community Development, Planning Division
rows.line: Chapter 25 of the Fairfield Municipal Code is the Zoning Ordinance; the page links its most-used sections, such as the residential, commercial and industrial zoning districts and the general development regulations on fences, setbacks and height limits.
rows.q: Where is Fairfield's zoning?
rows.a: Fairfield's zoning is Chapter 25 of the Fairfield Municipal Code, the Zoning Ordinance. The Planning Division's page links its most-used sections, including the land use and development regulations for residential, commercial and industrial zoning districts.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Vacaville Community Development, Building Division
rows.line: Reviews and inspects all new construction and improvements to existing structures within City limits under California's Title 24, with online permit applications, online payment and electronic plan review.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Vacaville?
rows.a: The City of Vacaville's Building Division reviews and inspects all new construction and improvements to existing structures within City limits, enforcing California's Title 24 building standards with local amendments. Its permitting software offers online permit applications, online payment and electronic plan review.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Vacaville Community Development, Zoning
rows.line: Links the City's Title 14 Municipal Code, its Zoning Map and common zoning topics.
rows.q: Where is Vacaville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Vacaville's zoning page links Title 14 of its Municipal Code and the City's Zoning Map.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Thornton City Development, Building Inspection Division
rows.line: Handles plan review, permit issuance and inspection of new construction and remodels of existing structures; payments can be made through the online portal at any time, and the 2024 International Codes took effect July 1, 2025.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Thornton?
rows.a: The City of Thornton's Building Inspection Division is responsible for plan review, permit issuance and inspection of new construction and remodels of existing structures. Payments can be made through its online portal at any time, and its page links a Permit and Property Search.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Thornton City Development, Zoning Districts, Uses and Regulations
rows.line: Every property has a zoning district approved by City Council, which sets its allowed land uses, setback and height requirements and development and design standards; the page links the Interactive Zoning and Property Map.
rows.q: Where is Thornton's zoning?
rows.a: Each property in the City of Thornton is designated with a zoning district, approved by the City Council, that determines its allowed land uses, setback and height requirements and development and design standards. The City's page links its Interactive Zoning and Property Map, and hardcopy maps can be bought at the City Development Department.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Longmont, Building Services
rows.line: Enforces building codes, conducts inspections and issues permits from the Development Services Center at 385 Kimbark St.; the City adopted the 2024 International Codes, effective July 1, 2026.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Longmont?
rows.a: The City of Longmont's Building Services Department enforces building codes, conducts inspections and issues permits from the Development Services Center at 385 Kimbark St. The City has adopted the 2024 International Codes, effective July 1, 2026.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Longmont, Planning and Development Services
rows.line: Responsible for land use, zoning, development review and growth management; its planning resources include the comprehensive plan, zoning maps and the land development code.
rows.q: Where is Longmont's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Longmont's Planning and Development Services department is responsible for land use, zoning and development review in the city. Its planning resources include the comprehensive plan, zoning maps and the land development code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Palmdale, Building and Safety
rows.line: Regulates the construction of all new, remodeled and existing residential, commercial and industrial buildings; every permit application goes through the Accela Citizen Portal, plan reviews are electronic, and inspections are scheduled online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Palmdale?
rows.a: The City of Palmdale's Building and Safety division regulates the construction of all new, remodeled and existing buildings under the State of California's and the City's building codes. All permit applications are submitted through the Accela Citizen Portal, where inspections are also scheduled.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Palmdale, Planning
rows.line: Oversees application review, the General Plan, specific plans, the Zoning Ordinance and Map and annexations, and supports the Planning Commission.
rows.q: Where is Palmdale's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Palmdale's Planning division oversees development application review, the General Plan and specific plans, and the Zoning Ordinance and Zoning Map. It also supports the Planning Commission.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Lancaster Development Services, Building and Safety
rows.line: Issues permits, reviews all building plans for code compliance and inspects during construction; since January 1, 2026 new plan submittals must be designed to the 2025 California Building Code.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Lancaster?
rows.a: The City of Lancaster's Building and Safety division issues permits, reviews all building plans for compliance with code requirements and makes periodic inspections during construction. Since January 1, 2026, all new plan submittals must be designed to the 2025 California Building Code.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Lancaster Development Services, Current Planning
rows.line: Planning staff review every development and subdivision proposal for conformance with the general plan, specific plans, zoning ordinance and subdivision regulations; the page maps projects under review.
rows.q: Where is Lancaster's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Lancaster's planning staff review all development and subdivision proposals in the city for conformance with the adopted general plan, specific plans, zoning ordinance and subdivision regulations. The page includes a map of projects currently under Planning review.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Corona Planning and Development, Building Division
rows.line: Makes sure new development is built to the highest safety standards and existing structures are kept safe; from January 1, 2027, plan review submittals for major new development, including tract homes and residential infill lots, must be made online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Corona?
rows.a: The City of Corona's Building Division handles plan check and inspection. Its page links applying for a building permit, a permit history search and inspection requests, and from January 1, 2027 plan review submittals for major new development must be made online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Corona Planning and Development, Planning Division
rows.line: Works with developers on residential, commercial and industrial projects, reviews and issues permits for fences and walls, patio covers, signage and additions, and provides general zoning and General Plan information.
rows.q: Where is Corona's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Corona's Planning Division plans for the City's balanced and orderly growth, reviews and issues permits for fences and walls, patio covers, signage and residential and commercial additions, and provides general zoning and General Plan information.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Chino Development Services, Building Division
rows.line: Issues building permits, takes in plans for review and inspects residential and commercial structures; the City has adopted the 2025 California Building Code, with amendments in Chapter 15 of the Chino Municipal Code.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Chino?
rows.a: The City of Chino's Building Division issues building permits, takes in plans for review and inspects both residential and commercial structures. The City has adopted the 2025 Edition of the California Building Code, with its amendments listed in Chapter 15 of the Chino Municipal Code.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Chino Development Services, Planning Division
rows.line: Helps ensure land uses comply with the General Plan, Specific Plans and Zoning regulations, approves land use and other zoning applications, and updates the Zoning Ordinance with the Planning Commission and City Council.
rows.q: Where is Chino's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Chino's Planning Division, part of the Development Services Department, helps ensure land uses comply with the City's General Plan, Specific Plans and Zoning regulations. It approves land use and other zoning applications and, with the Planning Commission and City Council, updates the Zoning Ordinance as needed.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Inglewood, Building Safety Division
rows.line: Enforces minimum building standards through plan review, permit issuance and inspections; since March 30, 2026 inspections are requested online through OpenGov, and plan check submittals and over-the-counter permits need a QLESS appointment.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Inglewood?
rows.a: The City of Inglewood's Building Safety Division enforces minimum building standards through plan review, permit issuance and inspections. Since March 30, 2026, all of its inspections are requested online through OpenGov, and plan check submittals and over-the-counter permits need an appointment through QLESS.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Inglewood Planning Division, Zoning Codes
rows.line: Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code holds the Planning and Zoning regulations, which describe the zoning districts, land use classifications and regulations, and development standards.
rows.q: Where is Inglewood's zoning?
rows.a: Inglewood's zoning is in Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code, the Planning and Zoning regulations. They describe the city's zoning districts and land use classifications, land use regulations, development standards and environmental standards.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Downey Community Development, Building and Safety Division
rows.line: Responsible for building and safety standards for the design, construction, use and occupancy of all buildings in the City; applications and inspection requests are made online, and the counter is on the first floor of City Hall.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Downey?
rows.a: The City of Downey's Building and Safety Division is responsible for the building and safety standards for the design, construction, use and occupancy of all buildings and structures in the city. Application submittals and inspection requests are made online, and its counter is on the first floor of Downey City Hall, 11111 Brookshire Avenue.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Downey Community Development, Planning
rows.line: The Zoning Code describes the zoning districts, land use classifications and regulations, development standards and environmental performance standards; it is updated periodically, and the page links the online code.
rows.q: Where is Downey's zoning?
rows.a: Downey's Zoning Code describes the city's zoning districts and land use classifications, land use regulations, development standards and environmental performance standards. It is updated periodically, and the City's page links the online Zoning Code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Victorville, Building Division
rows.line: Administers and enforces the building code for the construction, alteration, demolition, repair and use of buildings in the City; permits are applied for on the Self-Service Portal, and plans are reviewed and approved by the Development Department.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Victorville?
rows.a: The City of Victorville's Building Division administers and enforces the building code for the construction, alteration, demolition, repair and use of buildings in the City. Permits are applied for on its Self-Service Portal, and plans are reviewed and approved by the Development Department before the permit is issued.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Victorville Planning, Check Your Zoning
rows.line: Every property in the City has a zone that sets its development regulations, such as allowed land use, maximum building height and minimum setbacks; the GIS Zoning Checker searches by parcel.
rows.q: Where is Victorville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Victorville designates every property with a zone that determines its development regulations, including allowed land use, maximum building height and minimum property line setbacks. Its GIS Zoning Checker is an interactive map that searches by parcel, and the approved Zoning Map is posted as a PDF.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Palm Desert, Building and Safety Division
rows.line: Reviews building plans, issues permits and conducts inspections so construction is consistent with state and local building codes; its plan review covers residential additions and alterations and commercial and industrial plans.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Palm Desert?
rows.a: The City of Palm Desert's Building and Safety Division reviews building plans, issues permits and conducts inspections, making sure construction is consistent with state and local building codes. Its plan review covers residential additions and alterations as well as commercial and industrial plans.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Palm Desert, Planning Department
rows.line: Manages land use, zoning and design review, supports property owners, architects and developers with their projects, and helps implement the City's long-range plans.
rows.q: Where is Palm Desert's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Palm Desert's Planning Department manages land use, zoning and design review, and supports property owners, architects and developers with their projects. It also helps implement the City's long-range plans.
